findings.highlight: my will to fight for survival almost disappears
findings.evidenceJa: 生きようともがいていた意思も消えかけた
findings.governingReading: even the will that had struggled to live was beginning to fade
findings.explanation: The remembered loss of will is shifted into the present and “to live” is recast as active combat.

findings.governingReading: I yearned for it with piercing intensity
findings.explanation: A strong but natural account of longing becomes a non-English collocation that can sound censorious.
mirror moon adds “all,” broadening Archer’s judgment beyond the specific antecedent Shirou is recalling.

findings.evidenceJa: 報われる事などないという、その末路
findings.governingReading: the end awaiting him, in which he will never be rewarded
findings.explanation: “Thankless” suggests lack of gratitude; the source says the course itself will yield no reward.

findings.highlight: I wanted to be a superhero
findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方になりたかった
findings.governingReading: I wanted to become an ally of justice
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu’s recalled formulation of the central justice ideal is replaced by superhero genre language.

findings.highlight: It’s not me that said that, but
findings.governingReading: It was not I who left those words behind, but—if I remember correctly—
findings.explanation: The interrupted recognition loses the marker that Shirou is reaching through uncertain memory.

findings.highlight: I don’t feel good at my awakening
findings.evidenceJa: 寝覚めはいいものじゃなかった
findings.governingReading: I had not woken in a pleasant state
findings.explanation: A routine expression for waking badly becomes an unnatural literal construction.

findings.evidenceJa: 空は惚れ惚れするほど青かった
findings.governingReading: the sky was blue enough to leave me admiring it
findings.explanation: The morning sky’s beauty and Shirou’s admiring response are reduced to color and clarity.

findings.highlight: I don’t have to go wake Fuji-nee up
findings.evidenceJa: 無理して藤ねえを起こすコトもない
findings.governingReading: there is no need to force Fuji-nee awake
findings.explanation: The point that Shirou need not make her wake unnaturally early on Sunday disappears.

findings.highlight: one extra person that’ll be eating
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂っていう余計な食い扶ち
findings.governingReading: an extra mouth to feed named Tohsaka
findings.explanation: Shirou’s comic household-budget idiom and explicit naming of Rin are flattened.
